description: See every thread that needs your answer in one list, each with a one-line summary of its latest result. Rows sort into Needs your response, In progress, and Paused, and you reply, pause, archive, or move a thread from its row. A bundled manager skill starts new work in a section the Feed watches and flags child results for you. Summaries use your Codex login (ChatGPT account or OpenAI API key); without it, a row shows the first sentence of the agent's latest message.
